subject: SpectralTech onsite — flight preferences and arrival coordination
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Kate Lewis <kate.lewis@spectraltech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SpectralTech onsite — flight preferences and arrival coordination

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for agreeing to host the onsite workshop with the SpectralTech product team. We're finalizing travel for our core crew and want to align on arrival/departure windows and any travel constraints on your side so we can consolidate PNRs and confirm pickups. Quick items: 

- Proposed Redwood arrival: Monday, Oct 5 by 4:00 PM local (we'll need hotel check-in and secure meeting room access that evening).
- Proposed Redwood departure: Wednesday, Oct 7 after 6:00 PM (we plan to wrap by 3pm on the 7th).
- Please confirm if SpectralTech prefers a single consolidated PNR per company or individual bookings per traveler. For executive attendees we can do meet-and-greet on arrival if desired.
- Any travel restrictions (direct flights only, preferred carriers, frequent flyer numbers, seat assignments, TSA Pre/Global Entry) or corporate policy we should honor?

I've attached the current mutual action plan for the workshop so you have visibility on timing and who needs to be onsite: SpectralTech_Onsite_MAPlan.pdf (attachment). Once we have windows and exec preferences we'll coordinate bookings and share PNRs and a consolidated pickup sheet.

Cc'ing Aditya (travel ops lead) and Monica (program manager) to handle the logistics on our end. If you want to route bookings through your travel partner, please loop them in or share a contact.

Thanks — looking forward to finalizing.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0164

From: Kate Lewis <kate.lewis@spectraltech.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Travel Ops <travelops@bookings.co>, logistics@spectraltech.com
Date: 2026-09-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SpectralTech onsite — flight preferences and arrival coordination

Hi Aisha —

Thanks — the windows you suggested work for us. A few specifics from our side: 

- Our CTO, Nishant Patel, will need to arrive Oct 5 and prefers arrival no later than 5:00 PM; he requires direct flights only and cannot do overnight red-eyes. He'll be traveling from BOS.
- Our Head of Product (H. Rivera) arrives Oct 5 as well but is flexible between 2–6 PM.
- For those two execs, we do ask for a meet-and-greet and an airport transfer. Our logistics team can cover transfers but prefers consolidated PNRs so pickups are grouped.
- SpectralTech policy: domestic economy is standard; upgrades require pre-approval — I'll flag any exceptions. 

I copied our travel partner travelops@bookings.co — they can coordinate bookings if Redwood prefers that flow. Otherwise, feel free to issue bookings and send invoices to procurement@spectraltech.com.

Attached: current attendee list and dietary restrictions (see inline).

Thanks,
Kate Lewis
Head of Corporate Programs | SpectralTech
kate.lewis@spectraltech.com | +1 617-555-0122

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-19T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SpectralTech onsite — flight preferences and arrival coordination

Aisha / team —

Following Kate's notes, I ran a quick pass on flights and put together three booking options for our Redwood travelers that keep the CTO and Head of Product on direct itineraries where required. Summary is attached: Redwood_booking_summary.xlsx (attachment). Highlights: 

- Option A (preferred): All Redwood travelers arrive Oct 5 midday–late afternoon on nonstop flights where possible; consolidated PNR for SpectralTech execs so pickups are grouped. 
- Option B: Staggered flights to reduce risk of a single delayed flight impacting all attendees; hotel shuttle will hold until 8:30 PM. 
- Option C (cost-saver): early arrival Oct 4 for cheaper fares, adds one night of hotel (we'd need approval for extra night).

I tentatively reserved seats (hold status) for five Redwood attendees under temporary PNRs. I'm including a short PNR list in PNR_list.csv (attachment) — will convert holds to tickets once Aisha confirms final roster and we have SpectralTech's preferred consolidation flow.

Questions for Aisha: 
- Confirm final roster (names + known FF numbers) by EOD Monday 9/21 so we can ticket.
- Do we route invoices to SpectralTech procurement or bill to Redwood and submit expense? Kate indicated procurement@spectraltech.com is ok if we bill them directly.

Team —

Quick direction from my side: please prioritize the CTO's direct-flight requirement and ensure a meet-and-greet is scheduled. Approve up to $150 per transfer for the CTO's ground pickup (Uber Black or equivalent). If Aditya's Option C is the only way to keep costs within our smaller travel budget, get explicit approval from SpectralTech procurement before booking the extra night.

Action items: 
- Aditya: Move forward to ticket the confirmed roster once Aisha confirms names; mark Nishant Patel as "priority executive" in our PNR notes.
- Monica: Once flights are ticketed, please confirm hotel check-in details and request early meeting-room access for Oct 5 evening (we need AV set by 5:30 PM).
- Aisha: Confirm whether SpectralTech wants us to coordinate pickups or hand off to their travelops partner. If they want us to coordinate, include billing instructions for the transfer.

Please keep the thread tight on approvals — I don't want delays on travel to jeopardize the workshop schedule.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP, Customer Experience | Redwood Inference
